{"metadata":{"description":"Irreversible secret-scrubbing guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): regex redaction of secrets before session-log persistence and model requests","id":"gh:1354194106","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-secret-scrub","slug":"jkt-check/dsh-secret-scrub","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","llm-security","privacy","redaction","secret-scanning"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Irreversible secret-scrubbing guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): regex redaction of secrets be"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"fore session-log persistence and model requests"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-secret-scrub"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文 | Changelog"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Irreversible secret-scrubbing guard plugin, extracted from the user-sensitive-information protection"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" strategy of the kaya-ai-terminal project and open-sourced standalone (Mainland China site: https://"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"www.yunhouai.com; international site: https://www.yunhou.ai). It rewrites text on its way to the ses"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"sion log and the model: when a configured rule matches a secret-shaped fragment — an access key, a b"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"earer token, a private key block — the fragment is replaced irreversibly with a `[REDACTED:<category"},{"id":"p4s6","text":">]` placeholder, so the durable log and the model request carry only the placeholder at the covered "},{"id":"p4s7","text":"ceholder, so the durable log and the model request carry only the placeholder at the covered points."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Runtime dependencies are `@deepseek-ai/cordis` (peer) and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`. The `@deepseek"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"-ai/dsh-*` peer packages are type-only and optional."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Use with dsh"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"This package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so installation is a single command — the plugin activates"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" with the default `balanced` scrub level and needs no credentials:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`dsh plugin add` applies the `cordis.patch.yml` shipped inside this package (mounting the plugin at "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"`balanced` level). To change the level or add custom rules, override the same id in the profile patc"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"h layer `~/.dsh/profiles/headless/cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Use as a standalone Cordis plugin"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"If you are not using dsh, you can also mount the plugin directly on a Cordis context:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The plugin mounts three prepended waterfall listeners that delegate first and then scrub whatever th"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"e rest of the chain admitted:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- `agent/pre-step` rewrites each step's admitted user messages before they reach the session log and"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" the model request. User messages are scrubbed at `inputLevel` — `aggressive` by default, regardless"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" of `level` — so pasted PII and credentials are redacted with the full rule table even when tool out"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"put stays quieter.
- `tools/post-execute` rewrites an accepted tool result's plain content.
- `tools"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"/ptc-dispatch-log` rewrites the durable `tool/code-dispatch` copy of a `run_code` sub-dispatch."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Field | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| `level` | `balanced` | Scrub depth for tool output: `minimal` runs tier 0 only, `balanced` adds ti"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"er 1, `aggressive` adds tier 2 — PII and the high-entropy fallback |
| `inputLevel` | `aggressive` |"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" Scrub depth for admitted user messages at `agent/pre-step`, independent of `level` |
| `disabled` |"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" `[]` | Built-in tier 1/2 categories to turn off; a tier-0 core rule cannot be disabled and fails th"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"e load |
| `extra` | `[]` | Deployment-added rules, active at every level: a unique lowercase-dashed"},{"id":"p19s6","text":" `category` plus a `pattern` compiled with `new RegExp(pattern, 'g')` |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Invalid configuration fails at startup with a clear error — an unknown or tier-0 `disabled` category"},{"id":"p20s2","text":", an `extra` pattern that does not compile, a category id that cannot appear in the placeholder, or "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"a duplicate category — never a silent fall-back."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Built-in rule tiers"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"`level` selects the highest active tier. Tiers 0–1 are prefix-anchored and tier 2 matches shapes (th"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"e patterns live in `src/rules.ts`):"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Tier | Active at | Categories |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| 0 — core secrets | every level; cannot be disabled | `private-key`, `private-key-truncated` (unclo"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"sed/orphaned PEM armor), `api-key` (generic `apikey` assignments), `aws-access-key`, `github-token`,"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" `google-api-key`, `deepseek-key`, `openai-key`, `anthropic-key`, `gitlab-pat`, `rollbar-token`, `st"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ripe-key`, `slack-token`, `slack-signing-secret`, `slack-webhook-url`, `npm-token`, `pypi-token`, `s"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"endgrid-key`, `twilio-key`, `digitalocean-token`, `shopify-token`, `telegram-bot-token`, `tavily-key"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"`, `age-secret-key`, `docker-pat`, `notion-token`, `supabase-token`, `linear-api-key`, `generic-sk-k"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"ey` (`sk-`/`sk_` fallback), `url-credentials` (connection-URL authority), `url-access-token` (OAuth "},{"id":"p24s8","text":"callback token), `generic-bearer` (bearer tokens and JWTs) |
| 1 — assignment and cloud-provider key"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"s | `balanced` and up | `env-var-secret` (uppercase assignments whose name carries KEY/SECRET/TOKEN/"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"PASSWORD as a whole `_`-delimited segment), `azure-storage-key`, `alibaba-access-key`, `key-assignme"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"nt` (the same assignment shape in any letter case, value-filtered) |
| 2 — PII and the high-entropy "},{"id":"p24s12","text":"fallback | `aggressive` only | `email`, `phone-cn`, `phone-intl`, `id-cn`, `credit-card` (Luhn-check"},{"id":"p24s13","text":"ed), `ssn-us`, `high-entropy` |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Use the engine directly"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The pure scrubbing engine is exported from `dsh-secret-scrub/rules` and has no Cordis dependency:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Redaction is one-way and regex-based. Unprefixed keys, secrets split across text blocks, and encoded"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" forms (base64-wrapped, URL-escaped) evade the conservative rule shapes by design. The tier-2 rules "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"match shapes, not proven secrets, so they trade false positives for coverage — an email address in a"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" task instruction is redacted as if it were a secret, and hash-like text (git SHAs, SHA-256 digests)"},{"id":"p29s5","text":" matches the `high-entropy` fallback at `aggressive`. Do not rely on this guard as the only control "},{"id":"p29s6","text":"against credential leaks."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"MIT — Copyright (c) 2026 jkt-check"}],"truncated":false}
